content.text: {"id": "mm6624a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 81 pregnancy losses for which placental and/or fetal tissues were submitted, 18 (22%) were positive by Zika virus RT-PCR."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 78/627 (12%) had one or more placental or fetal tissue specimen that was positive for Zika virus by RT-PCR."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among 546 live births with possible maternal Zika virus exposure, for which placental tissues were submitted"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Zika virus RT-PCR was positive on placental tissues from 38/363 (10%) live births"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "placental testing provided a confirmed diagnosis of recent maternal Zika virus infection for 10% of live births"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "compared with only 3/35 (9%) second trimester losses"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Overall, 78/627 (12%) had one or more placental or fetal tissue specimen that was positive for Zika virus by RT-PCR."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This report describes the evaluation of formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissue specimens tested for Zika virus infection in 2016"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "positive by conventional Zika virus RT-PCR and confirmed by sequencing of PCR products"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Tissue RT-PCR results are also summarized by maternal symptom status and trimester of infection or possible exposure."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Trimester of infection or possible exposure is based on symptom onset date for symptomatic pregnant women"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
